runtime_default.applies_when: no temporally eligible owner-attested restart-dwell profile is enabled

public_operational_reference.description: Published medium-pressure metal-hydride HRS operation reports automatic standby/restart around a 200 bar upper and 195 bar lower pressure boundary and a multi-minute thermal cycle.

engineering_basis.selection_rationale: 120 s is below the observed 176 s chronological minimum and provides a deterministic sampled-controller anti-chatter delay without fitting to a failed holdout.

claim_boundary.note: The guard reduces rapid READY/RECHARGE toggling in the virtual controller. Facility-specific restart timing must be confirmed before operational use.
